question: Should memory-lancedb autoCapture reject OpenClaw `EXTERNAL_UNTRUSTED_CONTENT` wrappers by default, or should users opt into that behavior through a new `captureFilter` config surface?
rationale: The source-level gap is real, but the permanent fix chooses a security default, adds or avoids plugin config surface, and changes what existing autoCapture users retain from external content.

options.title: Reject wrappers by default
options.body: Treat OpenClaw external-content wrappers as a host-owned capture boundary before `shouldCapture`, with focused memory-lancedb tests and docs.

options.title: Add captureFilter config
options.body: Implement the requested `excludeWrapped` option with schema, manifest, docs, and tests while preserving current default behavior for existing users.

options.title: Defer to provenance design
options.body: Keep this narrow issue open until broader memory trust/provenance work defines the canonical source-authority contract across storage and retrieval.

recommendation.title: Reject wrappers by default
recommendation.body: Treat OpenClaw external-content wrappers as a host-owned capture boundary before `shouldCapture`, with focused memory-lancedb tests and docs.
